pending: No reference: no screenshot shows the Colors panel or its pickers (spec: color-panel, not seen). The checks below hold the wheel and the spectrum, in a real browser, to the HSB colour model they draw and to the shared focus ring.

comparisons.name: areas-light
comparisons.description: The wheel and the spectrum at full brightness, Aqua. The disc is centred on 80, 80 with a radius of 60 pt; the spectrum is 240 x 120 pt at 200, 20. Every colour is computed from the HSB model: hue from the angle (anticlockwise from three o'clock) or the horizontal position, saturation from the radius or the upper half, brightness from the lower half. The spectrum's points have the widest tolerance: its gradients change by up to 6 levels per point, and at 1x the pixel that is read is centred half a point beyond the point named.

pixels.note: wheel, half way out at three o'clock: hue 0, saturation 50% (HSB model, documented)
wheel, half way out at twelve o'clock: hue 90, saturation 50%
wheel, three quarters out at nine o'clock: hue 180, saturation 75%
wheel, three quarters out at six o'clock: hue 270, saturation 75%
page in the corner of the disc's box: the area is round
spectrum, a sixth across at mid height: yellow at full strength
spectrum, half way across at mid height: cyan at full strength
spectrum, half way to the top edge: cyan at 50% saturation
spectrum, half way to the bottom edge: cyan at 50% brightness
spectrum, five sixths across and an eighth above the bottom edge: magenta at 25% brightness
